versions.content: The Os Low Proxy shall create one SwcMod- eSwitchEvent per configured SwCluCOsProxyDispatcherModeSwitchEvent container in the partition specific Service Software Component according [SWS_SwCluC_02272]. The attributes of the SwcModeSwitchEvent shall be set as following: • shortName is set according the container's shortName • startOnEvent is set to the RunnableEntity according [SWS_SwCluC_02273] related to the owning SwCluCOsProxyOsTaskDis- patcher container • activation value is set according the SwCluCOsProxyDispatcherActiva- tion parameter • mode s are created according the SwCluCOsProxyModeInstanceRef (s) where for each different PPortPrototype an RPortPrototype is created at the owing Service Software Component according [SWS_SwCluC_02272] and used as contextPort . • disabledMode (s) are created according the SwCluCOsProxyDisabledMod- eInstanceRef (s) where for each different PPortPrototype an RPortPro- totype is created at the owing Service Software Component according [SWS_SwCluC_02272] and used as contextPort .
